title: 45米FCB数字孪生
subtitle: 项目作用 · 三步走战略 · 近期行动
visual: Editorial cover: big title upper left; elegant 2D technical side/isometric view of a 45m fast crew vessel on harbor contours central right, with a teal wireframe digital counterpart. Along lower half three connected stage cards, left to right, with a subtle return arrow from physical-data card to first. Not a real ship blueprint; no fabricated dimensions except title 45米.
notes: 路线规划简报。三阶段共用场景、模型、数据与评价；不代表当前已实现或完成实船验证。L1定义依据用户本轮更正。

title: 数字孪生在项目中的作用
subtitle: 用可重复试验，利用有限的实船机会
groups: 批量运行风浪流与会遇场景
反复回放、校准模型、比较策略
visual: Three equal large panels with concrete illustrations: overhead encounter tracks and weather symbols; connected software modules on a test bench; vessel data recorder and a trajectory overlay. Top-to-bottom labels only supplied text. No invented percentages or performance claims.
notes: 减少每次上船才能发现的问题；扩展海试前后的研究窗口。价值来自可重复的物理/软件/数据试验，不以画面逼真替代验证。

title: L1提供共享态势
subtitle: 规划、避碰、导引、控制共用同一态势来源
groups: L1 传感器与态势融合
本船状态 · 目标航迹 · 环境估计
visual: Make an unambiguous architecture diagram. A wide prominent teal L1 bar in upper-middle with subtitle inside. BELOW it four boxes left to right: L2 规划, L3 避碰, L4 导引, L5 控制. Four separate thin teal downward arrows from L1 bar to EACH of four boxes (not just L2). Dark horizontal arrows connect L2 to L3 to L4 to L5 for plan/reference flow; label this row 计划与指令. Lower-right box 执行器与船舶 receives command arrow from L5. A return arrow from physical box goes around right edge back to L1, labeled 传感器反馈. L1 is not a mission-planning node. Keep all arrowheads clear and avoid crossing labels.
notes: 用户定义优先：L1=传感器与态势感知融合。图为逻辑合同；正式实现仍需航线/控制权仲裁及接口适配。L1输出含质量/时间戳，态势不等于仿真真值。
sources: User clarification: L1 sensors and situational awareness fusion, shared source for other layers

title: 数字孪生的四个组成部分
subtitle: 场景、船模、软件与数据共同构成验证平台
groups: 动力学、舵桨、时滞与饱和
观测误差、L1输入、三维展示
场景编排、记录、评价、回放
visual: Four large quadrant cards around a small illustrated fast crew boat, each with a distinct technical icon and exactly its supplied heading and detail. No additional center text. Use clear separation between sea-world model, physical plant, sensor visualization, and experimental evidence. Thin connections, not a tangled network.
notes: 职责可以是同进程模块，不要求拆微服务。外部Plant拥有位姿积分时，三维后端不重复计算运动。统一环境同时供载荷、感知与显示。

title: 三步走，共用一条验证闭环
subtitle: 阶段递进，采集准备并行前置
groups: Python实验 + 数字船 + 三维场景
真实ROS2节点 + 仿真设备接口
实船记录 + 模型校准 + 回归验证
信号清单 · 时间同步 · 记录演练
visual: Broad three-stage horizontal roadmap with stage cards across center. A return arrow from stage3 to stage1 labeled only 回归验证 if already in content; do not repeat text unnecessarily. Below, a single full-width parallel workstream band for 现在启动采集准备 and its detail, visually starting under stage1 and spanning all stages. No dates or promised durations.
notes: 三个阶段是统一平台的运行配置，不是重做三套系统。第三步采集方案不能等第二步完成才开始。

title: 第一步：接入Colav-Simulator
subtitle: 先完成一个可重复的环境避碰闭环
groups: 会遇场景 · 风浪流 · 模型参数
简化L1 → 避碰算法 → GNC → 船模
船舶运动 · 计划轨迹 · 环境载荷
场景配置 + 决策记录 + 三维回放
visual: A large left-to-right test pipeline, with three major input/execution/output areas and a fourth lower artifact strip. Illustrate vessel overhead trajectory under wind/current arrows; show display and recorder branching FROM computed ship motion, not driving it. Keep pipeline exact. 简化L1 is visibly tagged inside execution area.
notes: 第一步可用目标级/理想观测L1替身，但需明确注入层级。复用现有实验/GNC/船模；三维集成不同时改避碰求解器。

title: 第一步验收：过程与证据
subtitle: 能展示，也能复现和评价
groups: 对遇 · 交叉 · 追越 · 多船
监视 → 避让 → 通过 → 恢复
同一配置，开关显示结果一致
本船安全 · 全船安全 · 规则行为 · 任务完成
visual: Main upper-left-to-right large overhead harbor encounter trajectory with 4 sequential markers for 监视 避让 通过 恢复 grouped as a visual timeline. Beneath/alongside three readable callout cards for scenario coverage, reproducibility, evaluation. Trace sea-current directional arrows subtly. No numerical CPA claims, no green PASS stamps, no future straight line presented as accepted performance.
notes: 评价依据既有场景集和预先定义容差；验收未来待执行。物理载荷开关应能解释船舶响应，不能只检查海浪动画。

title: 第二步：真实ROS2全栈联调
subtitle: L1–L5运行目标软件，数字船替代实船设备
groups: L2 规划 → L3 避碰 → L4 导引 → L5 控制
传感器数据 ↔ 执行器命令与反馈
FCB船模 · 舵桨模型 · 风浪流
接口协作 · 模式切换 · 故障响应
visual: Two large lanes: upper blue-gray enclosure 真实ROS2软件 with L1 bar feeding each of L2-L5, horizontal plan chain. Lower teal/brown enclosure 数字船与环境 with boat, actuator, waves. Between them one conspicuous 仿真设备边界 with separate up sensor arrow and down actuator-command arrow. A right-side callout lists validation target. Clearly the actual software runs, model replaces devices. No third uncontrolled autopilot.
notes: 使用生产包/commit和真实DDS执行。既有嵌入式C++核心通过不等于ROS2全栈通过。L1融合也必须作为生产节点参与此阶段。逐模块换入，替身不能计入最终全链路验收。

title: 第二步先冻结四类合同
subtitle: 把时序、语义与控制权变成可验证接口
groups: 航线、速度、有效期、接纳反馈
唯一控制权、命令、实际反馈
visual: Four balanced technical contract cards, each with a distinct original icon (coordinate axes; route plan receipt; rudder/controller switch; clock/network). Thin shared connector below leads to a real ship control console illustration without new text. Clear sparse linework and consistent colored heading bars. No tiny JSON/code and no runtime PASS claim.
notes: 近期需要解决的具体缺口包括wall timer/物理wall dt、ROS2桥接、唯一积分和命令仲裁。use_sim_time本身不保证确定性；既有FMI wrapper未证明真实FMU执行。验收应包含真实节点、QoS、reset、故障和目标硬件时间行为。

title: 第三步：采集可校模的数据
subtitle: 同时记录命令、反馈、状态与当时态势
groups: 位置、航向、速度、IMU、风流与装载
舵桨指令、实际反馈、模式与接管
原始传感器、融合航迹、时间与质量
MCAP + 原始文件 + 参数版本 + 校验清单
visual: Central illustrated FCB with three instrument callout groups for navigation/environment, actuator console, radar/GNSS/target fusion. All feed a prominent lower archive/data-package block. Show dual separate traces from commanded rudder and measured rudder but no invented chart values. Recording equipment not assumed physically installed. All supplied Chinese text exact.
notes: 原生频率与丢帧统计，保留设备时间和接收时间。海流/波浪未测时标注未测而非伪造真值。MCAP和原始视频/雷达旁路文件共用manifest和时钟映射。设备库存仍需团队确认。

title: 四种回放，四种问题
subtitle: 分清历史事实、模型预测与策略假设
groups: 同样舵桨输入，船模响应是否一致？
同样观测，新算法会提出什么动作？
执行新动作后，仿真结果会怎样？
visual: 2x2 matrix of four equal illustrated cards: recorded solid trajectory; measured vs predicted trajectories; fixed sensor data feeding alternative decision blocks; branching vessel tracks with a new sensor viewpoint. Subtle consistent linework. First card brown factual, last teal hypothetical, middle complementary. Question text large and correct, one question per card. No invented performance comparison.
notes: 反事实船位改变后，旧相机/雷达画面不能作为新位姿反馈；需重新生成观测或限定目标级近似。历史目标不响应是假设，不能宣称真实交互。seek需重置/快照与预热，不是播放器移动位置即可。

title: 模型校准与船长行为分析
subtitle: 物理响应和决策意图分别建立证据
groups: 时钟与坐标 → 执行器 → 船体 → 环境残差
何时避让、怎样操纵、何时恢复
按航次留出数据，检查多步预测
通过回归后更新模型，意图依靠复盘标注
visual: Two paired columns: left measured and simulated vessel trajectory overlay with parameter gear; right captain console and event timeline. Across bottom two clearly separated cards for independent validation and update principle. Delicate diagram arrows. No claim that behavior cloning identifies intent automatically; no neural net or RL depicted as required first step.
notes: 先灰箱校准，再根据残差考虑SINDy/学习方法。按独立航次切分，避免相邻采样随机打散泄漏。船长轨迹只支持行为推断，不能独自证明意图/最优性。更新离线候选，非自动更新船载控制器。

title: NTNU经验与平台选择
subtitle: 借鉴分层与验证方法，保留后端替换能力
groups: 海事模型 + 三维传感器 + 自治软件
仿真同步不等于实船验证
Colav编排 · ROS2集成 · 可替换三维后端
visual: Three-layer cutaway technical illustration of vessel model, virtual sensor rays, software modules across upper two-thirds, with four clean callout text regions. Lower-right small toolbox/plug connectors indicating replaceable backends. No university logo, no Google Gemini imagery, no unsupported mature-production checkmark. Keep named text exact and no extra product labels.
notes: 来源：Autoferry Gemini (2020), Hanssen game thesis (2022), milliAmpere2 design/testing (2025), Berg syncing (2025), Menges predictive/RL (2024), Kandemir SINDy (2025)。Gemini公开适配器ROS1、主仓库归档；PyGemini仅列研究候选，不承诺安装成熟度。SINDy有小型Otter数据但不直接迁移FCB参数。

title: 近期可立即启动的四项工作
subtitle: 先明确接口与数据，再完成最小联调
groups: 各层负责人：字段、单位、频率与控制权
船模负责人：参数来源、缺口与适用范围
仿真负责人：外部位姿、时钟与重置
采集团队：信号清单、同步与离线回放
visual: A practical 2x2 workboard with four large cards; each has the exact title plus proposed responsible role/detail. Small line icons for interface contract, hull parameter binder, scene connector, recorder. Cards numbered nowhere. No calendar dates or duration promises. Precise readable text is central, minimal decoration.
notes: 角色为建议分工，非已获团队承诺。每项产物：接口字典v1；参数台账；构建/外部位姿驱动记录；可离线回放的数据演练包。现在就可启动，先确认同事包版本和设备数据可获得性。

title: 首个可验收切片
subtitle: 一艘FCB、两艘目标、一组风浪流
groups: 既有避碰算法 + 简化L1 + 数字船
三维同步显示避让与恢复航线
开关显示结果一致，记录可回放
接真实ROS2节点，持续准备实船采集
visual: Strong closing slide: large overhead schematic encounter with one clearly emphasized ownship FCB and exactly TWO other vessels. A gently curved ownship avoidance route visibly rejoins its mission route; wind/current subtle symbols, no numerical safety claims. Four short grouped text cards arranged around readable scene. Emphasize a concrete proposed experiment, no congratulations or thank-you text, no acceptance PASS seal.
notes: 这是建议的首个实施切片，结果待实际运行；三维只订阅已计算状态。配置/模型哈希、trace、载荷、评价与回放为交付证据。执行范围先冻结，之后推进ROS2全栈及真实数据校准。
